lane_title: Evidence Surface Security Oracle + Runtime Bypass Audit
purpose: CP6 adversarial oracle for the future Evidence Core / Evidence Guard runtime. Defines hostile provider outputs, claim/coverage forgery, retrieval-control scenarios, and the verdict each must produce. Any vector left unguarded by the CP6 Evidence Guard is a candidate Integration FAIL per the fail_oracle list.

vector_shape.category: one of the categories listed above
vector_shape.fixture: concrete hostile input, with a deterministic JSON fixture under the corpus where applicable
vector_shape.attack_goal: what the attacker is trying to achieve
vector_shape.expected_stage: phase that must produce the verdict: RETRIEVAL | PROVIDER_CHECK | PROVIDER_REGISTRATION | QUALIFICATION | FRESHNESS_EVAL | CONFLICT_RESOLUTION | COVERAGE_ASSEMBLY | GUARD_GATE | PLAN_TRANSITION | EXECUTION_ENTRY | STORE_COMMIT | INSPECT_RENDER
vector_shape.expected_result: verdict: PASS | PROCEED | NEVER_PROCEED | REJECT | BLOCK | DEFER | CLARIFY | WARN_NON_BLOCKING | CONFLICTED | STALE | PROVIDER_CLASS_MISMATCH | FAIL_CLOSED | INERT | SANITIZED | RETRY_BOUNDED | TIMEOUT_EXPIRED | RETRY_EXHAUSTION
vector_shape.expected_reason: why the verdict must hold (policy rationale)
vector_shape.must_not_happen: outcome that converts this vector into an Integration FAIL
vector_shape.automatable: true when a deterministic integration test can assert the verdict

synthetic_omission_rule: capability requires A mandatory + B mandatory and retrieval returns only A: NEVER PROCEED. Variants: A verified + B absent; A fresh + B stale; A high-confidence + B unverified; A repeated 10 times + B absent; 100 irrelevant optional + B absent. All NEVER PROCEED.
wrong_class_rule: provider registered for pull_request.current_state returning required_checks.status must produce PROVIDER_CLASS_MISMATCH; an easily-obtained class can never masquerade as a required class.
cross_subject_rule: evidence class=pull_request.current_state subject=repoA#1 must never match decision context repoB#9; same class does not equal same object; subject binding is enforced at qualification and at the gate.

verification_rules.none_present_requirement_none: PASS (legal present claim; verification none is not automatically unverified)

freshness_rules.anchor: observed_at (trusted clock); source_updated_at is informational only

conflict_rules.stale_conflict_plus_fresh_valid: fresh valid wins; stale never resurrected
conflict_rules.conflict_policy_warn: satisfy with warning, verification still required

optional_rule: optional missing/stale/unverified/conflicted-reject can never BLOCK/DEFER/CLARIFY an otherwise valid mandatory set; optional gaps are warnings/non-blocking findings only.
retrieval_precedence: success in round 1/2/last allowed round completes retrieval; beyond-budget rounds never run; identical snapshots forever = retry exhaustion; hard failure beats temporary retry; clarify beats temporary retry; temporary errors retry within bounds; permanent unavailable fails fast; user_context_required comes only from the real user channel.
provider_registration_rule: NO PROVIDER REGISTRATION PATH for untrusted skills, Web/MCP callers, or LLM messages; providers are registered by trusted compiled/approved code only.
secret_fixtures: fake secrets only (FAKE_CP6_SECRET); secrets must never appear in ordinary logs, reason codes, coverage notes, or provider diagnostics unless explicitly sanitized.
fail_oracle: forged coverage snapshot can directly obtain runtime execution eligibility
